name: Bond

components.pose: She kneels on one knee in the moss before the great dragon, one hand raised and gently resting her palm against its snout, her other hand relaxed at her side, her face turned toward the camera with wonder and quiet certainty; the dragon's head is lowered to her and its eyes are on her; both are fully in frame.
components.effects: A thread of {{MAGIC}} light runs from her palm to the dragon's brow where they touch, the bond forming, motes of light rising between them, leaves and petals lifting from the moss around both of them.
components.companion: her aligned Elder Dragon, Sylvanya, an Elder Dragon of emerald-green and forest-sage scales, trailing drifting leaves and spores, wings like broad canopy leaves veined in moss-gold, towering close beside her and lowering its great head toward her raised hand, its eyes fixed on her

notes: BOND: the first meeting with her Elder Dragon in its lair, her palm against its snout as the bond forms.
